Air India Express suspends crew after Dubai flight

Air India Express suspended eight crew members, including pilots, following a flight from Dubai to Amritsar. While initial reports suggested a potential alcohol-related issue, subsequent checks found no alcohol present. The airline has not publicly disclosed the specific reasons for the suspension, but the action has drawn attention to internal screening processes. The Gurugram academy was mentioned in relation to Air India's screening procedures.
